text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
(The rain was cold, my legs felt heavy...
Even so, the heat beside me burned just as intensely!)

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
(I see... So this is the Satsuki Sho!
The fiery battle to claim the Triple Crown――!)

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu, ahaha...! Ahahahahaha!!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: (Thank you, Ace!)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"...Haa, haa, haa!!
*Gasp*, haa...!!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ......Neither C.B. nor me...?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ...Damn it! Damn it all!!

text_block_list.name: Young Spectators
text_block_list.text: Eeeeh--!?

text_block_list.name: Young Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
T-The dream of the Triple Crown is over...
It's way too soon...!

text_block_list.name: Young Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
No, but... that was great.
You didn't take 1st, but I was totally captivated.

text_block_list.name: Young Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"That final straight was totally insane!
It looked like all the other Umamusume were standing still!"

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Spectator
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, true.
Mr. C.B. ran a great race!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Siiigh............
Yeah, I've got no clue.

The turf was an exceptionally heavy track,
and by the time she passed through the tunnel,
she was covered in mud from head to toe.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Man, there really are times when you can't even open your eyes.
I'm so glad we have a shower.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. Honestly, I was so frustrated.
But it all washed away down the shower drain.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"...I lost to her today.
I'll just have to settle the score at the Japan Derby."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Yeah... I'm all fired up!

The Japan Derby, where I've sworn to take revenge,
is the battle to decide the pinnacle of our generation.
I have to run through it without letting my guard down...!
